svg.title: Enterprise DevOps Platform reference architecture
svg.text: Commit to production on Azure: CI with DevSecOps gates, a signed software supply chain, GitOps delivery to AKS and SLO-driven operations.
Built and rebuilt from Git in every 3-hour KodeKloud Azure playground session.
AZURE · KODEKLOUD PLAYGROUND · ONE EXISTING RESOURCE GROUP · NO ROLE ASSIGNMENTS
Short-lived branches, one PR per change
Jenkins UI only through an SSH tunnel
No inbound webhook: Jenkins polls Git
Config as code (JCasC), jobs in Git
SonarQube + Docker on the same VM
secrets in tree and full history
Any red gate stops the build: no image
from the tested JAR · tag = Git SHA
signs the digest, key in Key Vault
CI commits the new digest for dev
prod changes only by pull request
Pulls Git and syncs the cluster
dev auto-sync · prod gated by PR
same chart and Argo CD apps
run on kind / k3d when AKS can't
kill pods, drain a node, write the RCA
lead time, deploy frequency, CFR, MTTR
FEEDBACK LOOP · SLO burn, alerts, RCAs and DORA trends go back into the backlog
FOUNDATION · EVERYTHING AS CODE · THE ENVIRONMENT IS DISPOSABLE
RG as data source · VNet, NSG, VM, ACR, KV, AKS
cloud-init VM build inside one session
Jenkins rebuilt, never restored by hand
the whole cluster state lives in Git
every 3-hour wipe is a DR test · RTO logged
dev and prod run the identical image; only Helm values differ
CI writes to Git, Argo CD pulls; no kubeconfig in Jenkins
commit SHA → image digest → SBOM + Cosign signature
infra, CI, deploy state in Git; any session rebuilds from zero
page on error-budget burn, each alert with a runbook and RCA
Terraform reads it as a data source
scripted rebuild from Git doubles as the DR drill
SCM polling + SSH tunnel, no public admin UI
Production equivalent: managed identity + AcrPull, GitHub webhooks via a private agent, private endpoints, Container Insights.
